subject: english
question:
Select the correct ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank and complete the following sentence.

He is always __active __in a party but _______ in the class.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"active"** means engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits; always busy and energetic. (सक्रिय)
 
 
• **Example: **He is very active and participates in various sports activities.
 
 
 
• **"Inert" **refers to lacking the ability or strength to move; lacking vigor. (निष्क्रिय)
 
 
• **Example: **He lay inert in his bed, unable to get up.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'active' **is **'inert'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Careless **(लापरवाह): Not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless driving led to an accident.
 
 
 
• **Angry **(क्रोधित): Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.
 
 
• **Example: **She was angry at the unfair treatment.
 
 
 
• **Naughty** (शरारती): (especially of a child) badly behaved; disobedient.
 
 
• **Example:** The naughty child was always causing trouble.
